definitions: A finely cut gemstone, especially a diamond, cut in a particular form with numerous facets so as to maximize light return through the top (called "table") of the stone.
One of many hummingbird species of the genus Heliodoxa.
The indentation or depression made by the pressure of one object on or into another.
The overall effect of something, e.g., on a person.
To manipulate a blank key within a lock so as to mark it with impressions of the shape of the lock, which facilitates creation of a duplicate key.
